title: NASA SpaceX Crew-12 prepares for departure from International Space Station
excerpt: The Dragon spacecraft hatch closed at 6:05 a.m. EDT on October 7, 2026, to begin return operations.
bodyHtml:
NASA announced that the SpaceX Crew-12 mission has initiated return operations from the International Space Station. The hatch between the SpaceX Dragon spacecraft and the orbiting laboratory was closed at 6:05 a.m. EDT on October 7, 2026.

The spacecraft is scheduled to autonomously undock from the station at approximately 8:05 a.m. to begin its return journey to Earth. NASA coverage of the undocking process is scheduled to begin streaming at 7:45 a.m. across multiple platforms.

Following the conclusion of the undocking coverage, NASA will distribute audio-only discussions between the Crew-12 members, the space station, and flight controllers during the transit of the Dragon spacecraft away from the orbital complex.

NASA plans to resume live coverage of the return operations at 10:20 a.m. on October 8, 2026, continuing through the splashdown of the spacecraft.
